description: Say that a failure is repaired, with a note on what was wrong and what fixed it. Only after it really is: the owner reads these to learn what was missed. The account that failed, its manager, a maintainer of the space or the owner.

allowTerms.description: Words you confirm are not private names

note.description: What was wrong and what fixed it, up to 1000 characters

ref.description: A commit, URL or thread that shows the fix

space.description: owner/name of the job (with job and slot, instead of id)

name: fix_incident
title: Mark a failure fixed
